newsitem.title: USA: NeoPharm submits NDA on cancer drug.
newsitem.headline: NeoPharm submits NDA on cancer drug.

text.p: NeoPharm Inc, a bio-pharmaceutical company, said Thursday it submitted a new drug application (NDA) on December 27 to the oncology division of the Food and Drug Administration.

It seeks FDA approval to market broxuridine for two separate indications -- as a radiation sensitizer in treating malignant gliomas or brain tumors (Broxine) and as an in-vivo prognostic test to measure tumor cell proliferation in breast cancer (Neomark-BU).
NeoPharm filed a single NDA, covering both indications rather than two separate applications, after preliminary discussions with the FDA.
About 15,000 new cases of brain cancer and more than 180,000 new cases of breast cancer are reported each year.

The company estimates the potential market for broxuridine to be in excess of $100 million per year. Upon approval, NeoPharm expects to market broxuridine in the U.S. market and seek licensing partners in international markets.
